feeding_claim.verbatim: this allows us to give them daily attention and raise them on lush green grass.

notes: Farm in Romulus (west Tuscaloosa County, near Northport); contact page gives a Buhl, AL address. Beef raised on the owner's father's property in Samantha, AL; page heading is Grass-Fed Beef with no finishing stated. Whole, half or quarter beef and whole or half pork. Pigs on pasture and woods with non-GMO feed; chickens range in woods and grass with non-GMO feed. Farm pickup by appointment; site offers daily delivery for a small fee but names no area. Second phone 205-534-5288. Barn2Door store not read.
